# Select

**Status:** Stable  
**Reviewed against:** GOV.UK Frontend 6.5.0 on 2026-09-09

Use a select when users must choose one option from a familiar list that is too long for radios.

## When to use

- Use for one choice from a moderately long list whose options users already understand.
- Order options predictably and select a value only when a genuine default exists.

## When not to use

- Use radios for a small set because all options remain visible.
- Use an accessible autocomplete for a very long list such as countries when users benefit from search.
- Do not use a select for multiple choices unless research supports the native multiple-select interaction.

## Anatomy

- **Form group (required):** Groups label, optional hint, optional error and select.
- **Label (required):** A visible label is associated using for and id.
- **Native select (required):** A govuk-select contains semantic option elements and submits the selected value.

## Variants

| Variant | Element | Classes | Use |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Default | `select` | `govuk-select` | A single choice from a familiar option set. |
| Error | `select` | `govuk-select`, `govuk-select--error` | Redisplay an invalid or missing selection with a linked error message. |

## Behaviour and progressive enhancement

- Use the native select without replacing its keyboard and platform behaviour; no GOV.UK JavaScript is required.
- Validate the submitted value on the server against the allowed options.
- Retain the user's selection after a validation error.

## Accessibility contract

- Associate one visible label and reference hint and error IDs with aria-describedby.
- Do not use size or multiple attributes without testing their more complex interaction.
- Avoid a disabled placeholder as the only instruction; use a label and hint.

## Content rules

- Write a clear question in the label and concise option labels.
- Sort alphabetically, numerically or by a user-understood priority.
- Do not preselect an answer merely to avoid a blank value.

## Token references

- `govuk.color.input-border`
- `govuk.color.error`
- `govuk.color.focus`
- `govuk.color.focus-text`

## HTML examples

### Country selection

```html
<div class="govuk-form-group">
  <label class="govuk-label" for="country">Country</label>
  <select class="govuk-select" id="country" name="country">
    <option value="">Select a country</option>
    <option value="england">England</option>
    <option value="scotland">Scotland</option>
    <option value="wales">Wales</option>
  </select>
</div>
```
